name: io.github.volodymyrkoval/memrise-mcp
title: Memrise (unofficial)
description: Unofficial read-only MCP server for your own Memrise words and lessons

environmentVariables.name: MEMRISE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your Memrise password. Never stored; only a login token is cached.

environmentVariables.name: MEMRISE_LANGUAGE_PAIR_ID
environmentVariables.description: Which course (language pair) to read. Only needed if the account has several; language_pairs_list shows the ids.

environmentVariables.name: MEMRISE_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Cache folder, an absolute path. Default: the platform cache folder under memrise-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: MEMRISE_WORDS_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long the word list is cached, in seconds. Default 3600; 0 turns it off.

environmentVariables.name: MEMRISE_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to write debug lines to stderr.
